title: Create a Twenty company
intent: Create exactly one company from a user-supplied name and domain, after checking duplicates and receiving explicit confirmation.
instructions: Use query_companies when useful to inspect current delegated-user facts before proposing a write.
Call create_company with the exact company name and bare domain supplied by the user.
The server will normalize the proposal, check duplicates, show the exact effect for confirmation, execute at most once, and read it back.
After a successful result, open only the returned ui_path and observe the page before finishing.
If confirmation is denied or a write outcome is uncertain, stop; never retry the mutation.
